metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-81963: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.. Product: Windows
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-81963" or Message contains "WINDOWS" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
